description: This skill should be used when an approved plan (specs/NNN-slug/plan.md or docs/plans/*.md) must be executed or an interrupted Build run resumed — test-first tasks via fresh Developer subagents or inline, per-task spec-then-quality review, bounded fix loops with escalation rulings, a run ledger copied into the PR, preflight, worktree isolation, file-disjoint parallel tasks and unattended runs (the Build stage of the Agentic SDLC).
